fc-r1.label: Leading RCB run-scorer with two seasons or fewer at the franchise
fc-r1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fc-r1.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) GROUP BY pl.name

fc-r1n.label: Runs by that player for the franchise
fc-r1n.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fc-r1n.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) GROUP BY pl.name

fc-w1.label: Leading RCB wicket-taker with two seasons or fewer at the franchise
fc-w1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fc-w1.query: SELECT pl.name, COUNT(*) wk FROM dismissals x JOIN deliveries d ON d.delivery_id = x.delivery_id JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) AND x.kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY pl.name

fc-w1n.label: Wickets by that player for the franchise
fc-w1n.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fc-w1n.query: SELECT pl.name, COUNT(*) wk FROM dismissals x JOIN deliveries d ON d.delivery_id = x.delivery_id JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) AND x.kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY pl.name

fc-n.label: Players with two seasons or fewer at RCB
fc-n.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fc-n.query: SELECT pl.name, COUNT(DISTINCT x.y) seasons, MIN(x.y) first, MAX(x.y) last FROM ( SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) y, d.batter_id pid FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) UNION SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) y, d.bowler_id pid FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15)) x JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = x.pid GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY seasons DESC, pl.name

fc-runs.label: RCB leading run-scorers who played two seasons or fewer
fc-runs.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fc-runs.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) GROUP BY pl.name
